name: E. coli chemotaxis: receptor methylation (MWC clusters)
question: Does the output return to its set point after a step of the input, and through which variable?

provenance.source: Tu, Shimizu and Berg, PNAS 105, 14855 (2008), doi:10.1073/pnas.0807569105: a = G(m, [L]) (Eqs. 2-4), f_m = alpha (m0 - m), dm/dt = F(a) piecewise linear (Fig. 2 legend); values from the text after Fig. 1 and the Fig. 2 legend

assumptions: mean field; ligand binding and kinase activity at quasi-equilibrium (as in the source)
K_A = K_I/C with C = 0.0062 (the source states C, not K_A)
time in units of 1/F(0) (F(0) = 1 in the source's simulations; physical F(0) about 7e-3 per s)
F(a) written as a line plus abs terms; identical to the source's piecewise-linear form, F(0) = 1, F(a0) = 0, F(1) = -2
steps of the background MeAsp concentration between K_I and K_A (the source's step values are in its supplement, not read)
observable: kinase activity a (FRET), and the bias of the flagellar motors

regulation.output: (1/(1 + exp(Nc*(alpha*(m0 - m) + log(1 + L/KI) - log(1 + L/KA)))))
